title: Where to Put an Explainer Video on Your Website (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: Where to Put an Explainer Video
slides.notes: You've made the explainer video. Now where does it go? In the wrong spot it's decoration; in the right spot it works every day.

slides.title: Start with the question, not the page
bullets: What does this company actually do?
Is the paid plan worth it?
slides.notes: Every explainer answers one question. Write it down, then ask where a visitor is when they have it. That's where the video goes.

slides.title: Place it where the question arises
slides.notes: Put home and pricing videos high on the page, walkthroughs beside the feature description, and help videos at the top of the matching article.

slides.title: One master deck feeds every page
bullets: Help centre: as long as the task needs
slides.notes: You don't need five separate productions. Duplicate one master deck, cut it down for each page, and adjust the speaker notes for the audience.

slides.title: Small details decide who presses play
bullets: Label: "See how it works in 2 minutes"
Before: "Welcome" / After: "Turn your deck into a narrated video"
slides.notes: Tell people what they'll get and how long it takes. Make the first frame a clear headline, and add captions for viewers browsing with the sound off.

slides.title: Make videos from decks you control
bullets: Edit the slide and speaker notes
Basic: try it first, no subscription needed
slides.notes: When the product changes, edit the slides and export again. On Pro, a.i. directs each video, turning ordinary slides into an extraordinary explainer. Start at powerpoint2vid.com.
